title: Make $1K an Hour With This Simple Side Hustle
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: Christmas light installation business
idea.one_liner: Install custom-cut roofline holiday lights, lease and store them, return yearly with 10% loyalty discounts; margins rise from ~20% year one to 50-60% by year three
idea.offer: professional holiday light install, maintenance and takedown
idea.revenue_model: $1,500-2,000 per average home, $800 minimum, priced per linear foot; commercial up to $40-50K

key_quotes.quote: >> An average home of this size is $1,500 to $2,000 for an install.
>> Year one will probably be in the 20% range cuz you're paying for that material for the first year and then year three uh will be around 50 to 60%.
One of the grounds guys that we were speaking with, he does a million and a quarter.

claims.claim: Insurance ~$12K/year incl. vehicles, GL, workers comp
claims.quote: >> With all of our insurance, which includes auto insurance and everything, we're paying about $12,000 a year for our vehicles, for our general liability, workers comp.
And then the install for a house about this size, uh, an hour to an hour and a half.

claims.claim: Startup material $400-500 minimum; they spent $4,500-5,000 for ~15 homes
claims.quote: So you might, if you were just trying to get started, you might only be $400 or $500 as far as material
>> Yes, we do. We our typically about $800 is a minimum

acquisition_channels.details: 'box nine' door hangers on neighbouring homes during installs
Facebook before/after posts and Facebook ads
yard signs; Christmas in July early-booking discount campaign
commercial customer handed over by another Grounds Guys franchise

ideas.delivery: two-person crews, pre-bulbed spools prepared in shop, labelled strands and route density
ideas.other_uk_rules: Work at Height Regulations 2005 and public liability insurance; employer's liability insurance mandatory with staff

idea.name: Landscaping franchise adding seasonal lines
idea.one_liner: Grounds Guys franchise where mowing margins are 10-15% but seasonal holiday lighting and ice melt boost profit

key_quotes.quote: >> Margins for mowing is 10 to 15%. Particularly commercial.

idea.name: Permanent roofline lighting
idea.one_liner: Permanent lighting installs at 2-3x the price of seasonal, but one-time rather than recurring

key_quotes.quote: >> But two to three times more if you're installing permanent lighting.
I have a friend that that has a Christmas light business in Pennsylvania and he says he hates permanent lighting because it's one time.

idea.name: Landscape lighting expansion
idea.one_liner: Lighting company aims for $1M+/year combining holiday and landscape lighting within 2-3 years

key_quotes.quote: So if we continue to double down on all the holiday lighting and landscape lighting, you know, between those two, we'd like to be doing over a million a year
